fidelity_limitation: these are reactions of IDEAL constraints in a rigid-body model. They are resultants, not distributions. No area, no pressure, no stress and no deflection is computed anywhere, so none of these numbers can support a strength, bearing or wear statement.

how_measured.crank_bearing: MuJoCo force/torque sensor at a site on the crank axis
how_measured.crank_joint: MuJoCo force/torque sensor at a site on the crank pin
how_measured.guide: MuJoCo force/torque sensor at a site on the platform body
how_measured.platform_joint: the equality-constraint force rows for the connect

label: IDEAL JOINT / CONSTRAINT REACTION
